title: Meta gets to consumer AI device market before OpenAI, but Zuckerberg's strategy remains unproven
summary_full: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's new Muse Charm device is intended to put his company ahead of rivals like OpenAI and Google in AI agents and consumer hardware.
